title: P0 v2 private real-save aggregate performance evidence

acceptance.targetCoverage: Controlled private real-save Node runs at 10X with 99 AI; short speed probes do not establish full-duration performance at every speed.
acceptance.p0Gate: HOLD: engineering measurements do not grant release or gameplay Gate acceptance

sources.sourceTreeHashMeaning: SHA-256 over sorted compiled input source files and source JSON, before instrumentation; final tests/browser/build use this same frozen source.

input.aiReceiptCountBasis: Issuer faction role; independently verified AI=13906 and player=57 for this save. The autonomous prefix count happens to equal 13906 here; it is a separate category.

method.clock: savedAt=1700000000000; now advances by the requested real hours; world duration uses configured speed.
method.testCopyOnly: Only decoded test copies change legal 24h cap/speed. Original input is read only.
method.storage: fake-indexeddb; native Chromium persistence and interaction measurements are separate.
method.crossRuntime: Exact digests here compare Node V8 with itself before and after. Chromium uses a separate native before/after control; no world-state numeric tolerance is applied.
method.workerTransfer: Node MessageChannel structured-clone delivery; no rendering or Android storage is implied.
method.elapsedReference: No source/global timing wrappers or V8 CPU sampling. Two solo 6h runs are both retained.
method.instrumentation: Per-event order/type counts and average/max costs require wrapped runs; wrapper costs are material after optimization. Sampled CPU includes input initialization; pipeline CPU covers load/replay/save.
method.longBaseline: Original 24h baseline was cooperatively paused for clean testing and quota waits. Raw wall, paused and active elapsed are distinct. Active CPU percentages exclude V8 idle samples; CPU polling during pause remains included. No uninterrupted 24h speed ratio is claimed.
method.privacy: Aggregates, counts, function names and one-way equality digests only. No save payload, raw world, database rows, raw CPU trace or private filesystem path.
